summary.answer: Only while neither spectating nor dead, records current money and computes delta. Positive nonignored delta optionally updates the selected BountyCashEvent text and plays a random CashEvent1..5 clip; advances index modulo5. Clears _ignoreNextMoneyChange only inside the live-player guard. Initial previousMoney suppresses the first delta. Modulo can select index0; no repair or money grant is made.
